fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Homepage/LatestModelsByCategory.cy.js#Homepage - LatestModelsByCategory [en] TC-LMC-10: Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-LMC-10
**Title:** Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty
**Language:** en

**Description:**
On the default 3 Wheelers tab, open Check Offers and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown validation messages for name, mobile and location are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the default 3 Wheelers tab
2. Open Check Offers on one visible card
3. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
4. Verify all three required-field validation messages are shown
